title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Everything you need to know before booking your first session.

faqs.q: Do you provide financial or investment advice?
faqs.a: No. BitcoinStart Nordics provides educational sessions only. We do not provide financial, tax, or investment advice.
Our sessions are designed for beginners and curious individuals who want a simpler and more practical understanding of Bitcoin.

faqs.q: Are sessions online or in person?
faqs.a: At launch, sessions are offered online.

faqs.q: Do I need any prior knowledge?
faqs.a: No. Our sessions are beginner-friendly and designed to meet you where you are.
You will receive confirmation, the session details, and next steps by email.
Our sessions are currently offered in English and Swedish.
